boundaryRules: Feature modules may import shared UI, lib utilities, and generated API types.
Feature modules call backend APIs through src/lib/api-client.ts.
Shared UI must not import feature modules.
Zustand stores must not cache server-owned entities.
Components must not divide paise by 100 directly; use currency utilities.
Storefront and admin data must come from backend APIs, never frontend constants.
Backend API connection failures and backend API 404 responses must render the shared service-unavailable state on SSR customer/admin pages.
Frontend routes that do not exist must render the shared SHRESTA page-not-available route instead of a broken/default framework page.
Customer-facing UI copy must use SHRESTA/customer wording and avoid implementation language such as backend, API, DB, KV, S3, CDN, metadata, contract, snapshots, or events.
Browser cart and wishlist state may store only product IDs and quantities; rendered product truth must resolve from backend storefront responses.
Customer-facing product short and long descriptions must resolve from backend ProductCard responses; frontend copy is only fallback for stale responses.
Collection product filters must use backend metadata and the shared storefront resolver logic for every collection, not route-specific special cases.
Public category slugs such as silk-sarees and sarees must resolve to canonical backend family keys before filtering or showing category copy.
Store locator marker positions and zoom focus must use backend store coordinates in the client-only Leaflet map.
Login is required only at final confirm-and-pay/order placement, not for cart viewing or checkout review.
Admin server actions must forward Idempotency-Key and keep SHRESTA_ADMIN_API_KEY server-only.
API clients must use generated OpenAPI types once backend contracts exist.
